scenario: A 65-year-old male develops blurry vision, paresthesias, twitchiness, seizure, and cardiac arrest after receiving local anesthetic for a femoral nerve block and scalp laceration repair. The scenario focuses on recognizing local anesthetic systemic toxicity, seizure management, ACLS, and lipid emulsion therapy.
